propositions: The prelude show_ticket call executes before the try block that builds failure_diagnostic, causing RebarError exceptions to escape _recover without diagnostic context
When show_ticket raises RebarError, the exception bypasses the except LLMError handler where failure_diagnostic is constructed, resulting in None diagnostic
Bare LLMError is taken in raise_completion_workflow_failure when failure_diagnostic is None, dropping the primary run's aggregate_* budget and repetition keys and omitting the gate-error sidecar
Moving show_ticket inside the existing try block will route prelude failures to the stage='preflight' arm, which preserves the primary diagnostic with aggregate_* keys intact
The fix must not alter happy-path recovery or existing recovery-failure paths
